title: Modulo Arithmetic Unit
statement: Implement a combinational unit that computes the remainder of unsigned division a % b for 8-bit operands. If b is zero, the module should output zero. This is a datapath block for remainder arithmetic.
module_signature: module modulo_unit(input [7:0] a, input [7:0] b, output reg [7:0] remainder);
behavior: The unit must be purely combinational.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential division algorithms or loops with hidden state.
hint: Implement the remainder using combinational subtraction and comparison logic if needed.
